sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Decatur starts with wastewater removal
sections.text: We will use extraction or pumping suited to the accessible conditions to collect standing wastewater. Contaminated loose material and components approved for removal will be handled separately from surfaces being retained. The route for equipment and waste will be planned around that physical work, with unreachable sections clearly identified.

sections.title: Remove contamination from retained surfaces
sections.text: After bulk wastewater and debris are removed, we will clean accessible retained surfaces using methods suited to the material and its condition. Cleaning addresses remaining soil and residue; any appropriate disinfection is a further part of the treatment rather than a substitute for removing contamination. Material that cannot be adequately addressed in place will receive a separate removal or evaluation recommendation.

sections.title: Dry the assembly before replacement work
sections.text: We will evaluate the remaining moisture and explain the drying needed for the affected assembly. The progress record will distinguish wastewater collection, material removal, surface treatment and drying instead of treating pumping as the whole job. Pipe correction and replacement of removed components will have separate responsibilities before the area is covered again.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/decatur.estimate: The estimate will distinguish cleanup, access handling and drying from pipe service and reconstruction. Share the provider’s route requirements and the repaired line location so the sequence can be made practical.
